support.title: Letter of support
support.letter_text:
Dear traveler,

What you have traversed today calls for neither resolution nor conclusion.

The letters ask for nothing. They promise nothing. They hold a space — a space you have agreed to look at.

There is nothing to achieve. There is nothing to fix. What has opened remains open as long as you wish.

Take the time to let these symbols rest within you. They will work at their own pace, without your effort.

The silence that follows is as precious as the words that preceded it.

about.title: About
about.content: Zohar Cards is an application that builds a bridge between the ancient wisdom of Hebrew letters and modern design. Set within a sacred minimalist space, it invites you to draw cards, read deep interpretations, and experience each letter through meditation, Tehima (the dance of letters), or calligraphy. A true journey of introspection and connection to the hidden meaning of the world.
about.frank_lalou: Frank Lalou, calligrapher and writer, opens with this application a sensitive path into the heart of the 22 Hebrew letters, bridging symbolism, inner questioning, and transformation.

faq.title: Help & FAQ
faq.a1: Zohar Cards is a divinatory and meditative experience based on the Hebrew alphabet, its Kabbalistic symbolism (Zohar), and its resonance with our life path. It is not a classic tarot deck, but a tool for introspection.
faq.a2: It is not a fortune-telling or future prediction tool. Zohar Cards offers keys to understanding and avenues for reflection to illuminate your present situations.
faq.q3: How do I choose my draw style?
faq.a3: Go to Settings > Draw Style. You have several options depending on your sensory preference: 'Grid' (rational), 'Chaos' (shake the phone for the tactile), 'Fan' (classic), or 'Slider'.
faq.q4: How do I install the app on my mobile?
faq.a4: On iOS (iPhone/iPad): Open Safari, tap the Share icon at the bottom center, then choose 'Add to Home Screen'. On Android: In Chrome, tap the three dots at the top right, then 'Add to Home screen'.
faq.q5: How do I change the app language?
faq.a5: Go to Settings > Language and choose your preferred language. The interface and AI interpretations will be generated in this language.
faq.q6: How do I change the Hebrew font?
faq.a6: Go to Settings > Font Style to choose from several fonts (Classic Calligraphy, Modern, Handwritten, etc.) according to the aesthetic that inspires you most.
faq.a7: Credits are used to ask the AI (the virtual guide) questions during a draw. Each detailed question consumes one credit. You can recharge your credits from the Settings menu.
faq.a8: Frank Lalou is a recognized French essayist, writer, and calligrapher, specializing in Hebrew calligraphy. The letters used in this application are derived from his work and his artistic vision of the Hebrew alphabet.
faq.a9: Tehima (which means 'harmony' in Hebrew) is a meditative movement practice created by Tina Bosi and choreographed around the 22 letters of the Hebrew alphabet. You can learn more at https://www.tehima.com/ .
faq.a10: Yes, absolutely. The application uses GDPR-compliant servers and all connections are secure. Your personal information and draw history remain strictly confidential.
